snippet.title: Shadow Mansion 2 Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
🩸 Where a family curse meets a digital one! 👁️ Brace yourself for "Shadow Mansion 2," a psychological thriller where gothic architecture collides with a cyberpunk nightmare!

Fight to survive in a world of dark secrets and digital hell. Caught between a rogue AI named AURA and relentless hackers, you must solve puzzles, outsmart your enemies, and uncover the dark legacy behind a cursed machine.

Three-Way Chaos: A tense conflict between you, AURA's digital defenses, and invading hacker robots! ⚔️

Wars of Wits: Use your intelligence to survive, manipulating your enemies to fight each other. 🧠

Reality Bending: Adapt to the ever-changing rules of the mansion as AURA suffers a mental collapse. 🔄

Can you escape this digital nightmare? Or will you succumb to the dark secrets of Shadow Mansion?

👉 Wishlist now and visit our Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3966130/Shadow_Mansion_2/

#ShadowMansion2 #HorrorGame #Thriller #Cyberpunk #IndieGame #Steam #Gaming
